title: ObservationKind
description:
Closed observation-kind taxonomy for Stage 3.

Variants map one-to-one to the `BatchSink`/gRPC-service pairs that ingest them (`Record` → `BifrostIngestSink` → `wyrd.v1.BifrostIngestService`). Drift and Eval variants arrive in later stages; this enum is intentionally **not** `#[non_exhaustive]` — new variants require an explicit versioned contract change (review M-01).

oneOf.description: Columnar record batch destined for a Bifrost table.

table.description: Destination Bifrost table for the record batch.
